user.title: Sony Bravia (2011–2012)
user.description: Connect a Bravia TV from 2011 or 2012. Newer models (2013+) are supported by the built-in Sony Bravia TV integration instead.

data_description.host: IP address of the TV. Give it a fixed IP in your router.
data_description.mac: Needed to switch the TV on, because 2012 sets drop off the network in standby. Wake-on-LAN / remote start must also be enabled on the TV.

register.title: Put the TV in registration mode
register.description: On the TV, open Settings > Network > Home Network Setup > Remote Device / Renderer and choose Registration (wording varies by model). Then submit.

pin.title: Enter PIN
pin.description: Enter the PIN shown on the TV.

confirm.title: Confirm on the TV
confirm.description: Accept the request from "Home Assistant" on the TV with your remote, then submit.

reauth_confirm.title: Register again
reauth_confirm.description: The TV no longer accepts Home Assistant. Switch the TV on and submit to register again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TV. Make sure it is switched on and the IP is correct.
error.registration_rejected: The TV rejected the registration. Put it in registration mode and try again.
error.not_confirmed: The TV still rejects Home Assistant. Accept the prompt on the TV, or check the list of registered remote devices.
